messages.subject: Properly detemine total MVPA
parts:
Hello everyone,

Our research group uses GGIR to process the data on 24-hour movement behaviour. We want to know how much MVPA participants get in a week. 

We found a previous answer to determine total= unbouted + bouted, if bout.metric =4 is used (default). However, when we tried using this definition with the GGIR version 3.0_6, it did not align and bout.metric =4 is not in the new version anymore. What is the best way to determine the total MVPA in a week? Since there is no output variable for weekly PA.

Any help or insight you could provide would be greatly appreciated!

Luming
